results.requirement_text: Messages can then be sent bi-directionally between the server and network elements.
results.text_predicate:
Requirement 4.2/S4 (External Interface Requirements > Communications Interfaces):
Messages can then be sent bi-directionally between the server and network elements.
results.lean_predicate:
structure Message where
  content : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Input where
  serverMessages : List Message
  networkElementMessages : List Message
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Output where
  serverMessages : List Message
  networkElementMessages : List Message
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Spec : Contract Input Output where
  pre  := fun i => i.serverMessages.Nodup ∧ i.networkElementMessages.Nodup
  post := fun i o => o.serverMessages = i.serverMessages ∧
                     o.networkElementMessages = i.networkElementMessages

example : Spec.pre { serverMessages := [{ content := "hello" }],
                     networkElementMessages := [{ content := "world" }] } ∧
          Spec.post { serverMessages := [{ content := "hello" }],
                      networkElementMessages := [{ content := "world" }] }
                    { serverMessages := [{ content := "hello" }],
                      networkElementMessages := [{ content := "world" }] } := by
  unfold Spec; decide
results.bad_example:
example : Spec.pre { serverMessages := [], networkElementMessages := [Message.content "Hello"] } ∧ ¬ Spec.post { serverMessages := [], networkElementMessages := [Message.content "Hello"] } { serverMessages := [], networkElementMessages := [] } := by
  unfold Spec; decide

negative_examples.example:
example : Spec.pre { serverMessages := [], networkElementMessages := [Message.content "Hello"] } ∧ ¬ Spec.post { serverMessages := [], networkElementMessages := [Message.content "Hello"] } { serverMessages := [], networkElementMessages := [] } := by
  unfold Spec; decide
negative_examples.why: The output violates the bi-directional communication requirement by not updating the messages from the network element.
negative_examples.outcome:
not usable: Application type mismatch: The argument
  "Hello"
has type
  String
but is expected to have type
  Message
in the application
  Message.content "Hello"
